text: LXXVII. 1. Cha bhikkhave dhamme appahāya abhabbo uttarimanussadhammā alamariyañāṇadassanavisesaṃ sacchikātuṃ. Katame cha? 2. Muṭṭhasaccaṃ, asampajaññaṃ, indriyesu aguttadvārataṃ, bhojane amattaññutaṃ, kuhanaṃ, lapanaṃ. Ime kho bhikkhave cha dhamme appahāya abhabbo uttarimanussadhammā alamariyañāṇadassanavisesaṃ sacchikātuṃ. 3. Cha bhikkhave dhamme pahāya bhabbo uttarimanussadhammā alamariyañāṇadassanavisesaṃ sacchikātuṃ. Katame cha? 4. Muṭṭhasaccaṃ, asampajaññaṃ, indriyesu aguttadvārataṃ, bhojane amattaññutaṃ, kuhanaṃ, lapanaṃ. Ime kho bhikkhave cha dhamme pahāya bhabbo uttarimanussadhammā alamariyañāṇadassanavisesaṃ sacchikātun ti. [page 431] LXXVIII. 1-LXXIX. 3 Arahatta-Vagga. 431
